Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up Yahweh’s ark.
So Joshua rose up early in the morning and brought Israel near by their tribes. The tribe of Judah was selected.
I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.

people.name: Ai
people.line: A Canaanite city conquered by Joshua after initial defeat.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: Joshua rose up early in the morning, mustered the people, and went up, he and the elders of Israel, before the people to Ai.
translations.bsb: Joshua got up early the next morning and mobilized his men, and he and the elders of Israel marched before them up to Ai.
translations.kjv: And Joshua rose up early in the morning, and numbered the people, and went up, he and the elders of Israel, before the people to Ai.
translations.asv: And Joshua arose up early in the morning, and mustered the people, and went up, he and the elders of Israel, before the people to Ai.
